  INNOVATION NETWORK AGENDA

  ROSI PEDERSEN ROOM, SUITE 120, 1:00 PM

  KARLA.CORONA@LONGBEACH.GOV

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  26-54201  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Long Beach Workforce Innovation
  Network meeting of Thursday, December 11, 2025.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  26-54210  Recommendation to approve the Workforce Innovation and Opportunity Act
  (WIOA) policies impacting Adult, Dislocated Worker, and Youth.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  26-54211  Recommendation to receive and file a presentation on Labor Industry Data.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

4.  26-54212  Recommendation to receive and file a presentation on Long Beach Out of School
  Youth Data.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

5.  26-54262  Recommendation to discuss how to proceed with youth development goals for
  2026.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

  4811 AIRPORT PLAZA DRIVE
  ROSI PEDERSEN ROOM, SUITE 120, 1:00 PM

6.  26-54215  Recommendation to receive and file an update from the Business Engagement
  Team including worksite development, on-the-job training, job placement support,
  and rapid response to local layoff events.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

7.  26-54216  Recommendation to receive and file a discussion on the programmatic activities,
  initiatives, and strategies providing access to Adult, Dislocated Worker, and Youth
  with employment, education, training, and supportive services activities.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

8.  26-54218  Recommendation to receive and file an update on Grants.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

9.  26-54220  Recommendation to receive and file Chair’s Report.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

10. 26-54221  Recommendation to receive and file Executive Director’s Report.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Long Beach Workforce Innovation Network on non-agenda items. Each
speaker is limited to three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Chair.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

ADJOURNMENT

I, Alyssa Campos, City Clerk Specialist, certify that the agenda was posted not less than 72 hours
prior to the meeting.

NOTE: The agenda and supporting documents are available online at
https://longbeach.gov/cityclerk/meetings. If a special accommodation is desired pursuant to the
Americans with Disabilities Act, please contact the Workforce Development Board at (562) 570-
3650.
